title: When a change removes a skill entirely, should the end-of-change check ask for anything?
context: The end-of-change check only names added or edited skills, so a removal is unseen today. A removal adds no unchecked instructions, but it can take away something other people relied on; this decides whether removals pass quietly or leave a short record.
